class.name: CharacterSetting
class.brief_description: [color=green](User creatable)[/color] The CharacterSetting node is used to manage character voice settings, dialogue settings, and more.
class.description:
[b]Note[/b] • The [CharacterSetting] node must be added as a child node under the Character node in the res://Core/autoload/stagehand.tscn file.
The CharacterSetting node is used to manage character voice settings, dialogue settings, and more. This node inherits from [AudioStreamPlayer] and provides various features for playing character voices. Through this, you can create and manage characters.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

members.member: The font used for the character's dialogue.
The font size used for the character's dialogue.
The BBCode style applied to the entire character's dialogue text. This style is applied to the whole dialogue text, and different styles can be applied per individual line.
The [SpriteFrames] for the speech bubble head used in the character's dialogue. This [SpriteFrames] must consist of 50x50 frames, where each frame represents the animation of the speech bubble head.

A list of characters to which an extra delay is applied during typing. A longer delay is applied after characters included in this string.
The default value includes special characters and punctuation to provide a natural typing rhythm.

A list of characters for which the typing sound will not be played. The click sound will not play for characters included in this string.
The default value includes special characters, punctuation, and spaces to provide a natural sound effect.
